coex.title: Coexistence
coex.intro: Other security tools found on this server, and how InfraFence works alongside each of them.
coex.none: No other security tools were found on this server.
mode.coexist.text: Another active tool writes firewall rules. InfraFence keeps to its own chains and never edits theirs.
mode.primary.text: InfraFence is the only tool writing firewall rules on this server.
coex_action.coexist_csf: InfraFence keeps its own chain and never edits csf.conf, csf.allow or csf.deny. After csf -r it restores only its own jump. CSF ports change only when you ask from the dashboard.
coex_action.coexist_lfd: Both read the same logs and block on their own; lfd blocks stay in CSF, InfraFence bans stay in its own set.
coex_action.coexist_imunify: InfraFence leaves Imunify360's firewall, ipsets and WAF alone and keeps to its own chain; both block independently.
coex_action.coexist_imunifyav: Both scan files. InfraFence never deletes or moves a file on its own: quarantine only on request.
coex_action.coexist_cphulk: cPHulk blocks panel and service logins; InfraFence reads the same logs and bans at the firewall. cPHulk is not changed.
coex_action.coexist_fail2ban: Compatible: both only drop traffic. InfraFence does not touch fail2ban's chains.
coex_action.coexist_crowdsec: Compatible: both only drop traffic. InfraFence does not touch CrowdSec's rules.
coex_action.coexist_plesk_firewall: Plesk Firewall rewrites the rules when you apply changes; InfraFence never edits them and restores only its own chain within a minute.
coex_action.coexist_modsecurity: InfraFence reads the ModSecurity audit log for detections. Under a hosting panel it adds no ModSecurity rules: the panel owns the web server configuration.
coex_action.coexist_bitninja: InfraFence leaves BitNinja's firewall and WAF alone and keeps to its own chain; both block independently.
coex_action.coexist_monarx: Both scan files. InfraFence never deletes or moves a file on its own: quarantine only on request.
coex_action.coexist_firewalld: firewalld keeps its own rules; InfraFence's chain is independent and restored within a minute after a reload.
coex_action.coexist_ufw: InfraFence jumps to its chain ahead of ufw's rules; a ufw reload is repaired within a minute.
